# Perfetto Source Slice

Based on upstream commit `fd896b1ad88899807bb128b7255deb5199dde54f`.
Maintained directly in the Shotium repository.
Existing local modifications are retained directly in tree; no patch replay
is required. This source selection preserves implementations, headers, GN build
metadata, generators, licenses, and all tracked inputs identified in platform
dependency graphs.
This baseline passed all six platform builds for Shotium 0.6.0 at commit `07ac95e4a85dad12bc7fd8029c5ca229e3e38d9f`.
Refer to `apps/docs/upstream-sync-state.json` and `apps/docs/upstream-sync-0.6.0-validation.md`
for sync scope and validation details.
